Current music tracks: 44

Hey there! If you want to add your own music, first separate your song into it's intro (if it has an intro) and it's looping part in separate sounds, tag "-Start" at the end of the intro's name, then tag "-Loop" at the end of the looping part's name. (Jingles won't have these tags, as they aren't intended to loop.) Add the song's name into the "Add music" block, & finally drop it here! Remember that EVERYTHING must be correct spelling or else it won't work! Running a test recommended!

If the music track comes from a party game, like Mario Party, Wii Party or WarioWare: MEGA Party Game$, make sure it won't play for users who don't want those music tracks, like SmashBrosFan2020. If the music track gets faster overtime, make sure it won't play for users who don't want those music tracks, like Twin138956Scratch. Burgnew_On_A_Laptop also recommends you please don't add any more than around 60 music tracks total, to prevent lag or the dreaded "refusal-to-save glitch" when modifiying the project on less powerful devices. It's also best to refrain from adding too many music tracks longer than 3 minutes (180 seconds) or too many "gets faster" tracks.
